Rita / Lauren — quick techno-commercial note:

- Quantization: For reranking workflows where cosine similarity is sensitive, recommend a hybrid approach: keep the re-ranker model at 8-bit or 16-bit float where latency allows, and quantize the upstream generator to 4-bit. In our benchmarks that preserves >99% accuracy on ranking tests while reducing token-cost by ~40%.
- Batching: We can commit to dynamic batching with a 50ms max queuing SLO on Hosted API; for Dedicated pools we can guarantee sub-30ms median per-token latency at the stated QPS given proper batch sizing.
- Prefix KV caching: enable for templates and user-session caches; for ad-hoc queries do a 24-hour LRU cache at the routing layer. That typically reduces tokens by 18–25% for CivicAI-like workloads.

I'll attach a short tech appendix separately with benchmark numbers. If CivicAI wants a fixed-price pilot, we can size the Dedicated node hours required; I estimate 300 reserved GPU hours/month for the pilot footprint at peak concurrency.

- Aditya
Applied ML / Inference Performance

Thanks all — procurement asks acknowledged. Pricing options we can offer (summary):

Option A — Fixed-price pilot (recommended for procurement):
- 3-month engagement, fixed $75,000 (includes onboarding, 300 GPU hours, commercial support, two optimization workshops).
- Deliverables: MAAP, runbook, one quantization tuning pass, ramp plan.
- 0% overage billing (all in fixed price).

Option B — Credits pilot (flexible):
- 50k token credits + 2x spike buffer = estimated $52,000 list equivalent.
- Standard overage rates apply (with a 15% pre-approved discount if they convert to a 12-mo commitment within 30 days).

Discount structure for conversion to commit:
- 12-mo commit (usage-tiered): 10% platform discount + 1 custom support hour/day SLA tier.
- 24-mo commit or Dedicated pool: 18% platform discount + lower per-token egress and preferred slot allocation.

Caveats / notes:
- SOC2: we can provide the SOC2 type II report and a KMS integration checklist; redlines around data retention require legal review.
- If CivicAI insists on Guaranteed Tokens (fixed-price), we will size conservatively and include a usage reconciliation clause.

Rita — would you prefer Option A for procurement sign-off? If so we can generate an SOW and order form tomorrow.

Cheers,
